description: A 2HP hand controller giving one trigger, two gates and two fixed voltages, with no inputs at all

params.text: Fires a 1ms pulse at the Trig output each time it is pressed
Raises that gate output while it is held, or holds it high until the next press when its latch button is on
Makes the button beside it a toggle, one press taking the gate high and the next taking it low, in place of a gate that lasts while the button is held
Sets that fixed voltage, -10V fully counter-clockwise to +10V fully clockwise

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse at 10V, fired by the Trig button
Carries 10V while its button is down or latched on, and 0V otherwise
Carries the voltage its knob is set to

notes: the quantize and clipping settings on the menu reach the two CV outputs only; the trigger and gate outputs take their levels from the Gates and Triggers menus instead
menu: Trigger Polyphony: 1 (monophonic) up to 16 channels — sets how many channels the trigger output carries, all with the same pulse
Gate Polyphony: 1 (monophonic) up to 16 channels — sets how many channels the two gate outputs carry, all with the same gate
CV Polyphony: 1 (monophonic) up to 16 channels — sets how many channels the two CV outputs carry, all at the same voltage
Quantize mode — rounds the output to the nearest step of the size chosen, from a twelfth of a volt up to 5V, and is Off unless you set it
Clipping range — clamps every output to the range chosen, -12V to 12V unless you change it, and Off lets the output run to any voltage
Process quality: Audio, High, Balanced, Low, Very low — sets how often the module runs its algorithm, from every cycle down to every 256th; below Balanced a 1ms trigger can be missed
Gate-high output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while high, 10V unless you change it
Gate-low output-level — sets the voltage a gate output carries while low, 0V unless you change it
Trigger-high output-level — sets the voltage a trigger pulse carries during its 1ms high phase, 10V unless you change it
Trigger-low output-level — sets the voltage a trigger output carries between pulses, 0V unless you change it
